title: STATUS DETAIL TYPE AND HIERARCHY
why: The second reload-status review asks for a real 16px detail floor and quieter bonus text. Both apply to every status consistently. Watch: the active reload chain shows as a status with its count.
now: Status details use a 16px floor and muted ink below the larger status name.

edits.anchor: nf=FS(TYPE.head); vf=FS(TYPE.label);   // v28.xx (cw-cx-statusread): shared status type grows from about 16/13 to 20/16 px at 1080p.
edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-cx-statusdetail): the shared status detail has a real 16px floor before the existing resolution and TV scaling.
  nf=FS(TYPE.head); vf=FS(TYPE.label).replace(/([\d.]+)px/,function(m,n){ return Math.max(parseFloat(n),16*uiScale())+'px'; });
ctx.font=vf; ctx.fillStyle='#aaa498'; ctx.fillText(E.v||'',tx,cy+LH(11));   // v28.xx (cw-cx-statusdetail): style-guide tx-2 keeps the bonus below the status name in the hierarchy.
